quality_gate.notes: Evaluator (Wilson 95% CIs, Krippendorff alpha, Cohen kappa, G1-G6 gates) verified; 60-case licensed corpus and 30-case blind dual-reviewer held-out evaluation remain open.

scope_summary: Fidelis Studio v3.1.0 local region-aware restoration studio: protected linear-light composition (8-bit and 16-bit PNG + alpha/ICC managed export), bounded SQLite/NPY revision storage, SegFormer B0 confidence-gated mask suggestions, explicit structural ROI locks and internal drift screening, resumable batch export, and workspace snapshot/rollback protection.
known_limits: Local loopback HTTP service only (127.0.0.1); not an authenticated multi-tenant cloud service.
Provenance sidecars are unsigned execution records unless signed and verified with an external C2PA X.509 certificate.
SegFormer B0 automatic garment segmentation can spill onto embroidered patches and zipper hardware; explicit structural ROI locks or manual protection masks are required.
Sobel luminance gradient and block phase correlation are geometric/contrast heuristics, not semantic identity or OCR proof.
RealSR-DF2K, ESRGAN-Remacri, 4x-UltraSharp, and ATR-trained SegFormer B0 weights require commercial license clearance before commercial production deployment; RealeSR-general-v3 is BSD-3-Clause.

Live ComfyUI GPU texture worker qualification (F05-A/F06/F07), 60-case licensed photographic corpus & comparator runs (F12-A/F12), 30-case blind human signoff (F13), and physical Android/iOS touch hardware review (F08-B/F15) remain open.
